reason: The BEFORE code forwards the full `customTesters` array (which for `toMatchObject` includes `subsetEquality` and its contextual closures) into `a.asymmetricMatch(b, customTesters)`, so subset semantics do leak into the matcher's recursive `equals` calls — exactly the defect the commit/issue/PR document and that the added `isSubsetEqualityTester` filter removes; only the reviewer's `toEqual` example is imprecise since subsetEquality is injected only by `toMatchObject`.
